shortDescription: Configure Rudder Server parameters via APIs.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the parameter to set.

options.name: rudder_token
options.description: Providing Rudder server token. Defaults to the content of /var/rudder/run/api-token if not set.

options.name: rudder_url
options.description: Providing Rudder server IP address. Defaults to localhost.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Choosing either to ignore or not Rudder certificate validation. Defaults to true.

options.name: value
options.description: The value defined to modify a given parameter name.
